activities.title: State Transition Explorer
activities.instruction: Trigger UI events and observe how state changes cause the interface to update.

content.concept: Understand state as data that React tracks and uses to determine the rendered UI.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The component begins with its current state value.
The user performs an action such as clicking a button.
The event handler requests a state update.
React renders the UI using the new state.

activities.title: React Event Handler
activities.instruction: Match UI events with the handler that should respond to them.

content.concept: Update React state in response to user events such as click and change.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Controlled Input
activities.instruction: Arrange the data flow of a controlled React input.

content.concept: Build controlled UI by keeping the input value in React state and updating it through an event handler.
